note: Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth RD), the only campground in the Pryor Mountains, along Sage Creek. Access: the direct route from Bridger (Pryor Mountain Rd, then FR 2500 Powerline Rd, rocky single track) 'is not advised for campers or horse trailers' and the Forest Service recommends high clearance for it; for campers and trailers it recommends coming from the south via Warren, Quarry/Helt/Gyp Springs Rds, Crooked Creek Rd and FR 2308 (~2.5 hrs from Bridger). Pryor Mountain roads become impassable when wet. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page (updated May 5, 2026): fees corrected (derived free -> $10 single / $15 double, charged Memorial Day - Labor Day) with the half-price Senior/Access discount now on the entry; confirmed 12 sites, 30-ft trailers, vault toilets, no reliable water; added year-round season (full service 5/26-9/6) and 16-day limit. Not stated: reservations/FCFS (derived left). Alerts: none for Sage Creek or the Pryor roads. Note: dropped the wrong 'free' and restated values; kept the access directions.
flags: Criteria problem (access, judgement call): the Forest Service says the direct Powerline Road route from Bridger 'is not advised for campers or horse trailers. High clearance vehicles are recommended' (FR 2500, 'rocky and a single track'). It names a camper/trailer route from the south via Crooked Creek Rd (~2.5 hrs from Bridger, no clearance warning), so a 23-ft motorhome has an agency-recommended way in, but it is long and unpaved and the roads 'become impassable when wet'.

Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'not waterfront' but the Forest Service page says the campground 'is located along the banks of Sage Creek' (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/sage-creek-campground). Not changed.
